BOTH SIDES ARE empty-schedule, which here is a POSITIVE statement by the filer rather than an omission: each schedule page exists, prints its full 17-line ruled grid with every line untouched, and carries the filer's own HANDWRITTEN SLASHED ZERO on both of its printed anchors ('Subtotal for this page' and 'Total ... Received'). Zero rows are published and no sum is claimed. THE ARITHMETIC AGREES AND IS FULLY CLOSED: the summary page leaves line 1 blank in BOTH columns and line 2 Column A blank, but writes a slashed zero at line 4 ('Total Contributions Received, From Line 1 Column A') and at line 6 ('Total Expenditures Made, From Line 2 Column A') — the ADDENDUM A §A3 recovery, and here it applies cleanly because lines 4 and 6 carry an actual numeral (a slashed zero) rather than the bare dashes that defeated it on 860d1cab (§B2). So the promoted per-period Column A figures are 0 for contributions and 0 for expenditures, corroborated by each schedule's own printed footer zeros, and the ladder closes exactly: line 3 beginning -1,076.77 + line 4 zero = line 5 subtotal -1,076.77, minus line 6 zero = line 7 close -1,076.77. Column B is a MIXED cell set on this final report: contributions Year-to-Date is left wholly BLANK while expenditures Year-to-Date carries a real 1,076.77 — i.e. this filer did NOT zero his cumulative column the way his 2010 December report did, which is exactly the ADDENDUM C §C6 warning that neither behaviour can be assumed. Nothing cumulative was summed as an increment and no two covers were differenced. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither Yes nor No is ticked, an honest BLANK, never 'No' (§A4).
